stickyNote.text: Dense and careful and uncomfortable. What does it mean to be a short? Octavia is hiding.

text: It has been a long year.

The Katamari OST came on and within a whim was the impossibly clean room of my high school friend and my high school self. You can draw a straight line from here to there and find my musical taste along the way. Was this the first time I heard Japanese children sing?
There is always a new emotion.
